questions.question: The diagonals of a rhombus are 19 cm and 29 cm. Find its area.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a **Rhombus**, the area is always half the product of its **diagonals**.

Area = 1/2 × (d₁ × d₂)

Area = 1/2 × 19 × 29 = 551 ÷ 2 = 275.5

**∴ The correct answer is 275.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of first diagonal (d₁) = **19 cm**

Length of second diagonal (d₂) = **29 cm**

**Formula Used:**

Area of Rhombus = (d₁ × d₂) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e750a5726bd739cbaecf4c21af853ce8f12ded11bf3ccd8828440739158491c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Area = (19 × 29) ÷ 2

⇒ Area = 551 ÷ 2

⇒ Area = 275.5 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 275.5 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perpendicular Bisectors

The diagonals of a **rhombus** always bisect each other at a **90° angle** (perpendicularly).

Relation between Side and Diagonals

The side length **s** is related to the diagonals by: 4s² = d₁² + d₂² or s = 1/2 × √(d₁² + d₂²).

Perimeter of Rhombus

Since all four sides of a **rhombus** are equal, the **Perimeter** = 4 × side.

Area with Base and Height

The **area** can also be calculated as **Base × Height**, similar to a parallelogram.

questions.question: How many sides does a regular polygon have if each interior angle measures 150°?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any **regular polygon**, the sum of an **interior angle** and its corresponding **exterior angle** is always 180°.

Exterior Angle = 180° − 150° = 30°

The sum of all **exterior angles** of any polygon is always 360°.

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior Angle

n = 360° ÷ 30° = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Each **interior angle** of a **regular polygon** = 150°

**Formula Used:** Interior angle of a regular polygon with **n sides** = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a2e33c6e0aedbacc9a6b2832039680b159396bc4c636a4a4b3d2850cd6079ff.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 150 = [(n − 2) × 180] ÷ n

⇒ 150n = (n − 2) × 180

⇒ 150n = 180n − 360

⇒ 180n − 150n = 360

⇒ 30n = 360

⇒ n = 360 ÷ 30

⇒ n = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 sides.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

For any polygon with **n sides**, the sum of all interior angles is given by (n − 2) × 180°.

Exterior Angle Property

The sum of all **exterior angles** of any convex polygon is always 360°, regardless of the number of sides.

Regular Polygons

In a **regular polygon**, all sides are equal and all interior angles are equal. A polygon with 12 sides is specifically called a **dodecagon**.

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys two types of rice costing ₹32 per kg and ₹40 per kg. He buys a total of 45 kg of rice for ₹1600. The ratio of the quantity (in kg) of rice costing ₹32 per kg to that costing ₹40 per kg is
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Mean Price** of the mixture = 1600 ÷ 45 = ₹320/9 per kg.

Apply **Alligation** between ₹32 and ₹40 with mean price ₹320/9.

Ratio = (40 − 320/9) : (320/9 − 32) = 40/9 : 32/9 = 40 : 32.

Simplifying the ratio: 40 : 32 → 5 : 4.

**∴ The correct answer is 5:4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Cost of Type 1 rice = ₹32/kg, Cost of Type 2 rice = ₹40/kg, Total Quantity = 45 kg, Total Cost = ₹1600.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26fd3ab45fac8102b65b721041354ed356233a3c7757deaf67966c20ffc10f46.png] 

Step 1: Calculate **Mean Price (M)** of the mixture.

⇒ M = Total Cost ÷ Total Quantity

⇒ M = 1600 ÷ 45 = 320/9

Step 2: Let **Quantity 1** be Q₁ and **Quantity 2** be Q₂.

⇒ Q₁ : Q₂ = (Price₂ − M) : (M − Price₁)

⇒ Q₁ : Q₂ = (40 − 320/9) : (320/9 − 32)

⇒ Q₁ : Q₂ = (360 − 320)/9 : (320 − 288)/9

⇒ Q₁ : Q₂ = 40/9 : 32/9

⇒ Q₁ : Q₂ = 40 : 32 = 5 : 4

**∴ The correct answer is 5:4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alligation Rule

It states that (Quantity of Cheaper / Quantity of Dearer) = (Rate of Dearer − Mean Rate) / (Mean Rate − Rate of Cheaper).

Mean Price

The **Mean Price** is the cost price of a unit quantity of the mixture obtained by mixing two or more ingredients.

Mixture Calculations

If two ingredients of concentrations C₁ and C₂ are mixed in ratio n₁:n₂, the resulting concentration Cₐvg = (n₁C₁ + n₂C₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).

questions.question: A swimming pool is fitted with three pipes. The first two pipes working simultaneously, fill the pool in the same time as the third pipe alone. The second pipe alone fills the pool 5 hours faster than the first pipe and 4 hours slower than the third pipe. In what time will the second and third pipes together fill the pool?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Time₃ = x**, then **Time₁ = x + 9** and **Time₂ = x + 4**.

Apply the rule: If 1/A + 1/B = 1/C, then **C = √(a × b)** where A = C+a and B = C+b.

**Time₃** = √(9 × 4) = **6 hr**; therefore **Time₂** = 6 + 4 = **10 hr**.

Together (2 & 3) = (10 × 6) ÷ (10 + 6) = 60/16 = **3 3/4 hr**.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 3/4 hr.**

questions.question: A car travels from City A to City B at a speed of 60 km/h. After reaching City B, the driver increases the speed by 20 km/h for the return journey. Due to road repairs on the way back, the car is forced to slow down for 30 minutes, during which it travels at only 30 km/h instead of the increased speed. If the total time for the round trip is 7 hours, find the distance between City A and City B.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **Distance** between **City A** and **City B** be **D**.

Forward time = D ÷ 60; Return speed = 60 + 20 = 80 km/h.

Return journey includes 15 km (30 km/h × 0.5 hr) at 30 km/h and (D − 15) km at 80 km/h.

Total time equation: (D/60) + 0.5 + (D − 15)/80 = 7 ⇒ (D/60) + (D − 15)/80 = 6.5.

Multiplying by **LCM** 240: 4D + 3D − 45 = 1560 ⇒ 7D = 1605 ⇒ D = 229 2/7 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 229 2/7 km.**

questions.question:
A shopkeeper offers the following schemes on toys of the same marked price.

(A) Successive discounts of 50% and 16% on any number of toys bought.

(B) Successive discounts of 49%, 8% and 13% on any number of toys bought.

(C) 35% discount on the first 6 toys and 45% discount on each toy thereon.

(D) On buying eight items, the customer is billed for only four items.

A customer wants to buy 8 toys. Which of the above schemes is the least beneficial to her?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Scheme A:** Successive 50% and 16% ⇒ 50 + 16 − (50 × 16 ÷ 100) = 58%.

**Scheme B:** Successive 49%, 8%, and 13% ≈ 59.18% (Multiple successive drops).

**Scheme C:** 8 toys ⇒ (6 × 35% + 2 × 45%) ÷ 8 = (210% + 90%) ÷ 8 = 37.5%.

**Scheme D:** Buy 8, pay for 4 ⇒ 4 free ÷ 8 total × 100 = 50%.

The **least beneficial** scheme is the one with the **minimum total discount** (37.5%).

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme C.**

questions.question: Evaluate 24³ + (-5)³ + (-19)³
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **Algebraic Identity**: If a + b + c = 0, then a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Here, a = 24, b = −5, and c = −19.

Checking the sum: 24 + (−5) + (−19) = 24 − 24 = 0.

Result = 3 × 24 × (−5) × (−19) = 72 × 95 = 6840.

**∴ The correct answer is 6840.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The expression is 24³ + (−5)³ + (−19)³.

**Formula Used:** a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca).

⇒ Let a = 24, b = −5, and c = −19.

⇒ Calculate the sum (a + b + c): 24 + (−5) + (−19) = 24 − 5 − 19 = 0.

⇒ Since (a + b + c) = 0, the expression (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca) becomes 0.

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = 0

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

⇒ Substituting the values: 3 × 24 × (−5) × (−19)

⇒ 72 × 95

⇒ 72 × (100 − 5) = 7200 − 360 = 6840.

**∴ The correct answer is 6840.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

General Cubic Identity

The expression a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc is always equal to (a + b + c) × 0.5 × [(a−b)² + (b−c)² + (c−a)²].

Conditional Identity

If a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc, it implies that either a + b + c = 0 or a = b = c.

Square of Trinomial

The square of a sum of three terms is given by (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2(ab + bc + ca).

questions.question: If a:b = 12:13 and b:c = 4:5, what is a:c?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the ratio between the **first term (a)** and the **last term (c)**, directly multiply the given ratios.

a/c = (a/b) × (b/c)

a/c = (12/13) × (4/5) = 48/65

**∴ The correct answer is 48:65.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The ratio **a:b** is 12:13 and **b:c** is 4:5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a509e69c2e084bb6378383788748c3257677a95291fdfa31ed85e99a562ddae0.png] 

To find **a:c**, we can express the ratios as fractions:

⇒ a/b = 12/13

⇒ b/c = 4/5

⇒ Multiply the two equations: (a/b) × (b/c) = (12/13) × (4/5)

⇒ The common term **'b'** cancels out: a/c = (12 × 4) / (13 × 5)

⇒ a/c = 48/65

This result matches **Option 3** provided in the question.

**∴ The correct answer is 48:65.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, the result is called a **compound ratio**. For ratios a:b and c:d, the compound ratio is (a × c) : (b × d).

Continued Proportion

To find the combined ratio **a:b:c**, make the common term **'b'** equal by multiplying the ratios by suitable constants. Here, a:b:c = (12×4) : (13×4) : (13×5) = 48:52:65.

Duplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a:b is simply the ratio of their squares, i.e., a² : b².

questions.question: The price of a jacket is first increased by 20% and then decreased by 25%. If the original price was ₹600, what is the final price of the jacket?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net percentage change formula = x + y + (xy / 100)

Net % change = 20 − 25 − (20 × 25 / 100) = −5 − 5 = −10%

Final Price = 90% of 600 = 0.9 × 600 = 540

**∴ The correct answer is ₹540.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Original **price** of the **jacket** = ₹600, **First increase** = 20%, **Second decrease** = 25%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e47b0d94d8d765cc3316b5e611ca1885debeab177f746851730a495718cb3d9c.png] 

⇒ First price increase = 20% of 600 = (20/100) × 600 = ₹120

⇒ Price after **increase** = 600 + 120 = ₹720

⇒ Price decrease = 25% of 720 = (25/100) × 720 = ₹180

⇒ **Final price** of the **jacket** = 720 − 180 = ₹540

**∴ The correct answer is ₹540.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value is changed by x% and then y%, the net change is given by (x + y + xy/100)%. Use positive values for increase and negative for decrease.

Fractional Multiplier Method

For a 20% increase, multiply by 1.2 or 6/5. For a 25% decrease, multiply by 0.75 or 3/4. Final Value = Initial Value × Multiplier₁ × Multiplier₂.

Base Change Property

A change of +20% followed by −20% does not return the value to its original state; the net change would be a 4% decrease (loss).

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of 10 observations is 42. Three of the observations are 30, 38, and 50. The remaining six observations have an average of 45. Find the missing observation.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net deviation from the **overall mean** (42) must be zero.

Sum of deviations = (30 − 42) + (38 − 42) + (50 − 42) + 6 × (45 − 42)

⇒ −12 − 4 + 8 + (6 × 3) = −16 + 8 + 18 = +10.

Since the existing 9 numbers are +10 above the mean, the 10th number must be 10 below the mean.

⇒ Missing observation = 42 − 10 = 32.

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total observations = 10 | Total **Arithmetic Mean** = 42

First 3 observations = 30, 38, 50 | **Average** of next 6 = 45

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a762d5a6f250cc0d29e888324e3ed8b16a050b981c81b15700d93dacebac4b12.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Sum = Mean × Number of observations

⇒ Total Sum = 42 × 10 = 420

⇒ Sum of 3 known observations = 30 + 38 + 50 = 118

⇒ Sum of next 6 observations = 45 × 6 = 270

⇒ Sum of 9 observations = 118 + 270 = 388

⇒ Missing observation = Total Sum − Sum of 9 observations

⇒ Missing observation = 420 − 388

⇒ Missing observation = 32.

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean Formula

Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Number of observations). To find a missing value, subtract the sum of known values from the total sum.

Sum of Deviations

The algebraic sum of the deviations of a set of values from their arithmetic mean is always **zero**. ∑(xᵢ − mean) = 0.

Weighted Mean

When different groups have different averages, the combined mean is (n₁ × x₁ + n₂ × x₂ + ...) ÷ (n₁ + n₂ + ...).

questions.question: Two taps can fill a cistern in 4 hours and 12 hours, respectively. A third tap can empty it in 12 hours. How long (in hours) will it take to fill one-fourth of the empty cistern if all the taps are opened together?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume **total capacity** of cistern = 12 units (LCM of 4 and 12).

**Efficiency** of Tap 1 = 3, Tap 2 = 1, and Tap 3 (emptying) = −1.

Combined efficiency when all opened = 3 + 1 − 1 = 3 units/hr.

Target work = 1/4 of total capacity = 12 ÷ 4 = 3 units.

Time required = Target units ÷ Combined efficiency = 3 ÷ 3 = 1 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 1 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Tap A to fill = 4 hr

Time taken by Tap B to fill = 12 hr

Time taken by Tap C to empty = 12 hr

**Formula Used:**

Efficiency = Total Work ÷ Time

Total Efficiency = EfficiencyA + EfficiencyB − EfficiencyC

⇒ Net efficiency of all taps = 3 + 1 − 1 = 3 units/hr

⇒ Target to fill = 1/4 of cistern = 1/4 × 12 = 3 units

⇒ Time required = 3 units ÷ 3 units/hr = 1 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 1 hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns Basics

Filling pipes have **positive efficiency**, while emptying pipes (leakage) have **negative efficiency**.

Capacity Relation

Total capacity = Time taken to fill/empty × Efficiency of the pipe.

Time and Work Analogy

The concept is identical to **men and work**, where an emptying pipe acts like a person destroying the work.

questions.question: The HCF and LCM of two positive integers are 36 and 7,560, respectively. If one of the numbers is 540, what is the other number?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The product of **two numbers** is always equal to the product of their **HCF** and **LCM**.

Other number = (**HCF** × **LCM**) ÷ **Given number**

Other number = (36 × 7,560) ÷ 540

Other number = 7,560 ÷ 15 = 504

**∴ The correct answer is 504.**

questions.question: A sum of ₹8,000 is borrowed at a simple interest rate of 5% per annum for 3 years. What is the simple interest payable?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total interest percentage = **Rate** × **Time** = 5% × 3 = 15%.

**Simple Interest** = 15% of ₹8,000.

SI = (15 ÷ 100) × 8,000 = 15 × 80 = 1,200.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Principal (P)** = ₹8,000

**Rate of Interest (R)** = 5% per annum

**Time (T)** = 3 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf7bc3a8f1df6db63aedf5ad6a87c47057d7618b6df62206edea4d982ae4b293.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = (8000 × 5 × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 80 × 15

⇒ SI = 1,200

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,200.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Amount in Simple Interest

The total amount (A) is the sum of the principal and the interest: A = P + SI = P(1 + (R × T) ÷ 100).

SI vs CI for Year 1

For the first year, if the interest is compounded annually, the **Simple Interest** and **Compound Interest** are always equal.

Finding Principal from SI

If SI, Rate, and Time are known, the Principal can be calculated as: P = (SI × 100) ÷ (R × T).

questions.question: A cyclist travels 40 meters in 8 seconds. What is his speed?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Speed** in m/s = 40 ÷ 8 = 5 m/s

To convert **Speed** from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

**Speed** = 5 × (18/5) = 18 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 18 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Distance** traveled by the cyclist = 40 m

**Time** taken = 8 sec

**Formula Used:**

**Speed** = **Distance** ÷ **Time**

To convert speed from m/s to km/hr: Speed (m/s) × (18/5)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/596c012e455609b0243a804a1cef4241c67a2a1c539cd811367c22493b8b97d0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Speed** = 40 ÷ 8

⇒ **Speed** = 5 m/s

⇒ **Speed** in km/hr = 5 × (18/5)

⇒ **Speed** = 18 km/hr

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion (km/hr to m/s)

To convert speed from **km/hr** to **m/s**, multiply the value by 5/18.

Average Speed

**Average Speed** is defined as the **Total Distance** divided by the **Total Time** taken for the entire journey.

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the **opposite direction**, their **Relative Speed** is the sum of their individual speeds (u + v).

questions.question: The angle of elevation of the top of a building from a point 40 m away is 45°. What is the height of the building?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In any **right-angled triangle**, if the **angle of elevation** is **45°**, the **Height** (Perpendicular) is always equal to the **Distance** (Base).

Given **Distance** = 40 m.

∴ **Height** = 40 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 40 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance from the point to the **building** (Base) = 40 m

**Angle of elevation** (θ) = 45°

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular / Base

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ec80621944ac2f3fa3f1c1bb9c7e93011ae48e69f5177fedeccd6c443e547f4.png] 

Let the **height of the building** be h.

⇒ tan 45° = h / 40

⇒ 1 = h / 40 (Since **tan 45° = 1**)

⇒ h = 40 × 1

⇒ h = 40 m

**∴ The correct answer is 40 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Ratios Table

Key values for tan: tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, tan 60° = √3.

45-45-90 Triangle Property

In a triangle with angles 45°, 45°, and 90°, the sides are in the ratio 1 : 1 : √2.

Angle of Elevation vs Depression

The angle of elevation from an observer to an object is always equal to the angle of depression from the object to the observer.

questions.question: Find the mean proportional between (x + y)² and (x - y)², (x and y are natural number and x > y).
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ The **mean proportional** between any two numbers **a** and **b** is defined as **√(a × b)**. Given values: **a = (x + y)²** and **b = (x − y)²**. Mean Proportional = √[(x + y)² × (x − y)²] = (x + y) × (x − y). Using the **algebraic identity** (a + b)(a − b) = a² − b², we get **x² − y²**. **∴ The correct answer is x² − y².**

questions.question: If sqrt{x} = 5, what is the value of sqrt{x+25}?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given **√x = 5**, by squaring both sides we directly find **x = 25**.

The required value is **√(x + 25)**.

Substituting **x = 25**: √(25 + 25) = **√50**.

Since 50 = 25 × 2, the value is **5√2**.

**∴ The correct answer is 5√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The equation **√x = 5**.

**Formula Used:**

If **√a = b**, then **a = b²**. Also, **√(m × n) = √m × √n**.

**Calculations:**

⇒ **√x = 5**

⇒ Squaring both sides: **x = 5² = 25**

⇒ Required expression = **√(x + 25)**

⇒ Substitute **x = 25** into the expression: **√(25 + 25)**

⇒ Expression = **√50**

⇒ Expression = **√(25 × 2)**

⇒ **5√2**

**∴ The correct answer is 5√2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Root Properties

For any non-negative numbers, the property **√a × √b = √(ab)** allows for the simplification of surds by factoring out **perfect squares**.

Solving Radical Equations

To solve for a variable under a **radical**, isolate the radical term and apply the inverse operation (squaring for square roots).

Perfect Squares

Memorizing **perfect squares** like 25, 36, 49, and 64 helps in quickly identifying factors that can be moved outside the **√** symbol.

questions.question: Ritu gets a discount of 40% on an oven whose marked price is ₹1000. Since she pays by credit card, she gets an additional 22% discount. How much does she pay (in ₹)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **final price** is calculated using **successive multipliers**.

Net Multiplier = (100 − 40)% × (100 − 22)% = 0.60 × 0.78 = 0.468

Amount paid = **Marked Price** × Net Multiplier = 1000 × 0.468 = 468

**∴ The correct answer is ₹468.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Marked Price (MP)** of the oven = **₹1000**

**First Discount** (d₁) = **40%**

**Additional Discount** for **credit card** (d₂) = **22%**

**Formula Used:**

Final Price = **MP** × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fe6d9aa36f4f725af358718f593a5073d16d35bb9bf1bce5fac2ed9776fca73.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after the first **40% discount** = 1000 − (40/100 × 1000)

⇒ Price after first discount = 1000 − 400 = **₹600**

⇒ Additional **22% discount** is applied on **₹600**

⇒ Additional discount amount = 22/100 × 600 = **₹132**

⇒ **Final amount paid** by **Ritu** = 600 − 132

⇒ **Final amount paid** = **₹468**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹468.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Single Equivalent Discount

For two **successive discounts** of x% and y%, the **single equivalent discount** is given by (x + y − xy/100)%.

Marked Price and Selling Price

The **Selling Price (SP)** is always **Marked Price (MP)** minus the **Discount**. Discount is always calculated on the **Marked Price** unless otherwise stated.

Successive Percentage Change

This concept is used when a value is changed multiple times consecutively. The **order of discounts** does not change the **final selling price**.

questions.question: The largest four-digit number which when divided by 12, 13 and 7 leaves remainder 3 in each case is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find the **LCM** of the divisors: **LCM(12, 13, 7) = 1092**.

Identify the largest multiple of **1092** below **9999**: 1092 × 9 = **9828**.

Add the **common remainder** to the multiple: 9828 + 3 = **9831**.

**∴ The correct answer is 9831.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Divisors = **12, 13, 7**

Remainder in each case = **3**

Target = **Largest 4-digit number**

**Calculations:**

⇒ First, find the **LCM** of 12, 13, and 7.

⇒ 12 = 2² × 3

⇒ 13 = 13 (prime)

⇒ 7 = 7 (prime)

⇒ LCM = 12 × 13 × 7 = **1092**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dd959f722b69f980c4a2d8100a5445b27aa9df1a4ee75136f32c1d72d0e3d14.png] 

⇒ The **largest 4-digit number** is **9999**.

⇒ Divide 9999 by the LCM: 9999 ÷ 1092

⇒ 9999 = (1092 × 9) + 171

⇒ The largest 4-digit multiple of 1092 = 9999 − 171 = **9828**

⇒ Required number = Multiple + Remainder

⇒ Required number = 9828 + 3 = **9831**

**∴ The correct answer is 9831.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

General Form for Constant Remainder

Any number that leaves a remainder 'r' when divided by x, y, and z can be expressed as: **Number = [LCM(x, y, z) × k] + r**, where k is an integer.

LCM of Prime Numbers

The **LCM** of a set of numbers that are **co-prime** (like 7, 13, and 12 in this case) is simply the product of those numbers.

Smallest n-digit Number

To find the **smallest n-digit number** satisfying a condition, divide the smallest n-digit base (like 1000 for 4-digits) by the LCM and find the next higher multiple.

questions.question: A smart city metro line had an average of 4,500 daily riders last month. This month, it averaged 4,860 riders per day. What is the percentage growth in ridership?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net increase in **daily riders** = 4,860 − 4,500 = 360.

**Percentage growth** = (Change ÷ Initial Value) × 100.

Growth % = (360 ÷ 4,500) × 100 = 360 ÷ 45 = 8%.

**∴ The correct answer is 8%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average riders **last month** (Initial Value) = 4,500

Average riders **this month** (Final Value) = 4,860

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Increase = [(Final Value − Initial Value) ÷ Initial Value] × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63ae15727fc0570af9ebf8d74e135f65c8f374a6a23091e65509be6522373deb.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Absolute increase = 4,860 − 4,500 = 360

⇒ **Percentage growth** = (360 ÷ 4,500) × 100

⇒ Percentage growth = (360 ÷ 45)

⇒ Percentage growth = 8%

**∴ The correct answer is 8%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Change Rule

Always use the initial or original value as the denominator (base) when calculating **percentage growth** or **percentage reduction**.

Multiplying Factor

An 8% increase is equivalent to multiplying the original value by (1 + 8/100) = 1.08. Thus, 4,500 × 1.08 = 4,860.

Fraction to Percentage

The ratio 360/4,500 simplifies to 36/450 = 4/50 = 2/25. Since 1/25 = 4%, then 2/25 = 8%.

questions.question: A closed cylindrical reservoir features a radius of 14 cm and a height of 10 cm. If 20% of the total surface area of this reservoir is coated in blue paint and the remaining surface is coated in red, determine the total area in square centimeters that is painted red. [Use π = 22/7]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2 × 22/7 × 14 × (14 + 10) = 2112 cm².

Since 20% is blue, the **remaining red portion** is 80%.

**Red Area** = 80% of 2112 = 0.8 × 2112 = 1689.6 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 1689.6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Radius** (r) = 14 cm

**Height** (h) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a **closed cylindrical reservoir** = 2πr(r + h)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c49a1d6f6db1f34b621d96e3e42661926f6a8bbc179a6a3a0e2fb8ac232c5a0c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Surface Area = 2 × (22/7) × 14 × (14 + 10)

⇒ TSA = 2 × 22 × 2 × 24

⇒ TSA = 44 × 48 = 2112 cm²

⇒ Area coated in **blue paint** = 20% of 2112 = 422.4 cm²

⇒ Area coated in **red paint** = Total Area − Blue Area

⇒ Red Area = 2112 − 422.4 = 1689.6 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 1689.6 cm².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The lateral area of a cylinder excluding the top and bottom circles is 2πrh.

Volume of a Cylinder

The total capacity or space enclosed by a cylinder is given by πr²h.

Open Cylinder TSA

If a cylinder is open at one end, the surface area is πr² + 2πrh = πr(r + 2h).

questions.question: A shopkeeper purchases rice at ₹60 per kg. While selling, he uses a weighing scale that shows 1 kg when only 900 g is actually weighed. He marks the price 20% above the cost price. Later, he gives a 10% discount on the marked price but continues using the same faulty scale. Find his profit (in ₹) on each transaction where the buyer pays for 1 kg.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Selling Price (SP)** per **1 kg** displayed = 60 × 1.20 × 0.90 = ₹64.80.

Actual **Cost Price (CP)** for **900 g** given = (60 ÷ 1000) × 900 = ₹54.

**Profit** on each transaction = 64.80 − 54 = ₹10.80.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹10.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Cost Price (CP)** of **rice** = ₹60 per kg

**Mark-up percentage** = 20%

**Discount percentage** = 10%

**Faulty weight** = 900 g instead of 1000 g

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/29952f785bc314c620573a7583412ec326637740324f56d3833b68268bc29ca5.png] 

**Step-by-step Calculation:**

⇒ **Cost Price (CP)** of 1000 g = ₹60

⇒ **Marked Price (MP)** = 60 + (20% of 60) = 60 + 12 = ₹72

⇒ **Selling Price (SP)** = 72 − (10% of 72) = 72 − 7.20 = ₹64.80

⇒ Since the shopkeeper gives only **900 g** when the buyer pays for **1 kg**, we must find the cost of the actual quantity sold.

⇒ **Actual CP** for 900 g = (60 ÷ 1000) × 900 = ₹54

⇒ **Profit** = Selling Price − Actual Cost Price

⇒ **Profit** = 64.80 − 54 = ₹10.80

**∴ The correct answer is ₹10.80.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Dishonest Dealer Concept

Profit occurs in two ways: by increasing the price (markup) and by reducing the weight given. Net Profit % = [ (True weight − False weight) / False weight ] × 100 (when sold at CP).

Successive Percentage Change

If a value is increased by x% and then decreased by y%, the effective change is [ x − y − (xy/100) ] %.

Relationship between CP, MP, and SP

MP = CP × (100 + Mark-up%)/100 and SP = MP × (100 − Discount%)/100.

questions.question: Mary is 3 years older than her sister. If their combined age is 27 years, what is Mary's age (in years)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the **larger value** (Mary) when the **sum** and **difference** of two quantities are known:

**Mary's age** = (Combined Sum + Age Difference) ÷ 2

Mary's age = (27 + 3) ÷ 2 = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Combined age of **Mary** and **Sister** = 27 years

Difference in their ages = 3 years

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21ae3a59c14b5d370d1a0aebe4a78f567894626bded4e8ef49d687161c6fbf7c.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let the age of Mary's **sister** be x years.

⇒ **Mary's age** = x + 3

⇒ Total combined age = x + (x + 3) = 27

⇒ 2x + 3 = 27

⇒ 2x = 27 − 3

⇒ 2x = 24

⇒ x = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 years (Sister's age)

⇒ Mary's age = 12 + 3 = 15 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum and Difference Formula

If the sum of two numbers is S and their difference is D, then the larger number is (S + D) ÷ 2 and the smaller number is (S − D) ÷ 2.

Constant Age Difference

The **age difference** between two individuals remains constant throughout their lives; it does not change as they grow older.

Ratio Method for Ages

If ages are given in a **ratio** a:b, the difference between the ratio parts corresponds directly to the numerical age difference.

questions.question: Simplify sqrt{1624+sqrt{3225+sqrt{419+157}}} .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve the nested radical from the **innermost** part: **√(419 + 157) = √576 = 24**.

Proceed to the next layer: **√(3225 + 24) = √3249 = 57**.

Solve the final outer layer: **√(1624 + 57) = √1681 = 41**.

Shortcut logic: The result of **√(1624 + x)** must be slightly more than **√1624 ≈ 40.3**. Among the options, **41** is the only possible integer.

**∴ The correct answer is 41.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Expression:** √(1624 + √(3225 + √(419 + 157)))

**Simplification Steps:**

⇒ First, add the innermost numbers: **419 + 157 = 576**

⇒ √(1624 + √(3225 + √576))

⇒ Since **√576 = 24**:

⇒ √(1624 + √(3225 + 24))

⇒ Add the values inside the next root: **3225 + 24 = 3249**

⇒ √(1624 + √3249)

⇒ Since **√3249 = 57** (as 50² = 2500 and 60² = 3600):

⇒ √(1624 + 57)

⇒ Add the remaining values: **1624 + 57 = 1681**

⇒ √1681

⇒ 41

**∴ The correct answer is 41.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Root Properties

For a number ending in 1, its square root ends in either 1 or 9. Since 41² = 1681 and 49² = 2401, 41 is the correct root for 1681.

Perfect Square Identification

A perfect square never ends with the digits 2, 3, 7, or 8. This helps in quickly eliminating incorrect results during multi-step simplification.

Nested Radicals

Always solve nested radicals from **inside-out**. Simplification of the innermost root provides a whole number that completes the next perfect square.

questions.question: A company has 10 officers and 30 clerks. The average monthly salary of an officer is ₹45,000 and that of a clerk is ₹25,000. What is the average salary of the entire staff?

questions.question: A total of money is split among E, F, G and H in the ratio 9:7:5:3. If G gets ₹4000 less than F, how much does E receive?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **E : F : G : H** = 9 : 7 : 5 : 3

Difference between **F and G** units = 7 − 5 = **2 units**

Given, 2 units = **₹4000** ⇒ 1 unit = **₹2000**

**E's share** = 9 units = 9 × 2000 = **₹18000**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹18000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of distribution among **E, F, G, H** = **9 : 7 : 5 : 3**

Difference between share of **G and F** = **₹4000**

**Formula Used:**

Value of one unit = **Difference in values ÷ Difference in ratio units**

Individual share = **Ratio unit × Value of one unit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f60941db0531e486602060c89ceae60d5295da3dc564cc3cb77fdeef9ca8a31.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the amounts received by **E, F, G, and H** be **9x, 7x, 5x, and 3x**.

⇒ According to the question, **F − G = 4000**

⇒ 7x − 5x = 4000

⇒ 2x = 4000

⇒ x = 4000 ÷ 2 = **2000**

⇒ Share of **E** = 9x = 9 × 2000

⇒ Share of **E** = **₹18000**

**∴ The correct answer is ₹18000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Equality

Proportional Distribution

To divide a total amount **T** in the ratio **a:b:c**, the first part is **[a / (a+b+c)] × T**.

Compound Ratio

For two ratios **a:b** and **c:d**, the compounded ratio is **(ac) : (bd)**.

questions.question: A sum of ₹20,000 amounts to ₹21,218 in 2 years under compound interest, compounded annually. Find the rate of interest per annum.
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Ratio of **Amount (A)** to **Principal (P)** = 21218 : 20000 Divide both sides by 2 to get perfect squares: 10609 : 10000 Since the time is **2 years**, take the square root: √10609 : √10000 = 103 : 100 **Rate of Interest** = (103 − 100) / 100 × 100 = 3% **∴ The correct answer is 3%.**
